verdict.rationale: Omarchy provides an Install > Development menu section for quickly setting up development environments, plus preinstalled editors/IDEs (VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime, Helix) with theme matching, and default agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code). However, evidence doesn't detail specific framework/language templates or scaffolding beyond editor installation, and community feedback focuses on desktop/theming rather than dev environment specifics. Missing for 10: concrete list of supported languages/frameworks, evidence of one-click project scaffolding, independent hands-on validation of the Development menu setup experience.
